[https://github.com/changlabtw](https://github.com/changlabtw)

## Web Server

- [wpSBOOT](https://changlabtw.github.io/wpSBOOT/) — weighted partial Super Bootstrap
- [Transitive Consistency Score](http://tcoffee.crg.cat/core) — Estimate the confidence of the alignment
- [BigBigTree](http://tcoffee.crg.cat/apps/bigtree/) — Tree reconstruction for large orthologous family
- [PSI/TM-Coffee](http://tcoffee.crg.cat/apps/tcoffee/do:tmcoffee) — Transmembrane MSA
- PSLDoc3 — Protein Function Prediction

## Software

- [PSLCNN](https://github.com/changlabtw/PSLCNN) — Protein Subcellular Localization using Convolutional Neural Network
- [HiCmapTools](https://github.com/changlabtw/hicmaptools) — a commend line tool to access HiC maps. The complete program provides multi-query modes and analysis tools.
- [PSLDoc](https://github.com/jmchanglab/PSLDoc) — Protein Subcellular Localization Prediction based on based on gapped-dipeptides and probabilistic latent semantic analysis
- [FCS](https://github.com/warnname/FCS) — Finding Compact Set
